Every V1 feature is free — the lead pipeline, customers, tasks, bookings, invoices with PDF download, and the dashboard. BizOS runs on the free tiers of Supabase, Next.js and Vercel, so the cost of running it is zero, and no paid tiers exist yet.

Frequently asked questions

Is BizOS really free?+

Yes. Every feature in V1 — leads, customers, tasks, bookings, invoices and the dashboard — is free to use. BizOS runs on the free tiers of Next.js, Supabase and Vercel, and there are no paid plans at the moment.

Do I need a credit card?+

No. Signing up only asks for an email and a password. There is nothing to pay for and no card to enter.

Is my data private?+

Yes. BizOS uses Row Level Security on the database, which means your account can only ever read and write your own business data. Other users cannot see it.

Can I download invoices as PDF?+

Yes. Every invoice can be downloaded as a PDF file that you can send to your customers by email or any channel you use.

What happens to my data if I leave?+

Your data belongs to you. If you decide to leave, you can delete your account data from Settings and it is removed from the database.
